# Mister KD — Kadir Demir

> Kadir Demir ("Mister KD") is a functional food & beverage innovator, product architect and global market builder. Co-founder of Muscle Cheff (2015), founding board member of Smarter Snacks and Bite & More, co-founder of YOUNITED Gourmet Snacking (younitedsnacks.com). 1,000+ product trials, insights from 100+ countries. "Most Innovative / Creative Snack" at Natural Products Expo West 2026 (Smarter Snacks).

## Key facts
- [My creations](https://misterkd.com/#creations): 45 products across YOUNITED, Bite & More and Muscle Cheff — protein candy bars, cereal cups, cheese puffs, spreads, protein pancakes and waffles, vegan protein puffs, protein iced coffee, L-carnitine drinks, protein chips, cookies and chocolate.
- [Brands](https://misterkd.com/#brands): YOUNITED (building now), Smarter Snacks, Bite & More, Muscle Cheff.
- [Work with me](https://misterkd.com/#work): partnerships & co-creation, product & innovation consulting, retail & distribution (Türkiye, Gulf, Europe, North America), speaking.
- [Contact](https://misterkd.com/#contact): hello@misterkd.com, reply within 48 hours.
